name: Small Business 1071 Readiness Check
outcome: Check small business lending coverage readiness in two independent stages: first compute whether a financial institution meets the CFPB Section 1071 origination threshold from caller-supplied origination counts and validate SBLAR records against caller-declared required fields (ART-475); then a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). All origination counts, field lists, and SBLAR records are caller-supplied; findings are arithmetic findings, never coverage determinations. Federal only, not legal advice.
